content.text: The data show F3_Z01's sensor mean is ~24.6→~25.1°C from July 2018, while sibling zones (F3_Z02, F3_Z03) and F2_Z01 move with the season. However, with setpoint temperatures and zone-only data I cannot tell a genuine local load change (actual temperature rise from occupancy/equipment/equipment) apart from a sensor offset/drift: a true sensor fault with a constant bias would look identical to a real ~1.5°C temperature rise in monthly means. To separate them I would need independent corroboration — zone energy/occupancy (local load) or a redundant sensor.
